GitAgentProtocol (Open GAP) is a framework-agnostic, git-native standard for defining AI agents.
There's no universal, portable way to define an agent that works across Claude Code, OpenAI, LangChain, CrewAI, and AutoGen.
Composable — Agents can extend, depend on, and delegate to other agents
Drop these files into any git repo and it becomes a portable, framework-agnostic agent definition — everything else (CLI, adapters, patterns) builds on top of it.
